result.keyword: What's the best payment processor for a small online store?
result.markdown:
For a small online store, my recommendation would be **Stripe**, with **PayPal offered as an additional payment option**\.

However, the best choice depends on your website platform, where your customers are and how much you're selling.

Assuming you're operating in the UK, here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best payment processors for small businesses

![CPGIO - Multichannel eCommerce Solutions](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/PjgYNLsLO5kyHaLbRGf_vEGDklf86yBgljtBg18t7Dvw-WgJwtAR87t17RVnZQNRleNsnU2jfdTsx-hJkwGMn58MvL69dhGg6Mz4413HP_F8ItDmZVpm38tgVXpxLOBbHgVAgnhtZKjtJgc5PKyPg4Dx8NXHfNqw_93O-hccPsS0BrwP9sqrs9aaI_I6CV7n?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. Stripe**

(Best overall)

- Competitive UK card fees: around 1.5% + 20p.
- No standard monthly processing fee.
- Accepts cards, Apple Pay and Google Pay.
- Excellent integrations with WooCommerce and other platforms.

Best for: Most small online shops.

[Stripe UK pricing](https://stripe.com/gb/pricing)

---

![PayPal | 2024 Campus Forward Award Winner](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1CZkwu4XfsGi29HQm25jVqzyfcoAVt94osIFdG4Jj8i1ykjiTdkMc0sAUQttosT9d7348BNtDTI_LMzAYAAVQSAaA7t0VR8tZ2dLSQA2uJQWzrGyAfk_RjRmQZRYTdvd5dOIPliOCiFgcYeRgEL5JmA0u2Gw-Vro7HrBA62cIt2eLuB_AGLmV7TK3132kofQ?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. PayPal**

- Familiar and trusted by many shoppers.
- Easy to integrate.
- Supports PayPal wallet payments and card payments.
- Fees can be higher than alternatives.

Best for: Giving customers another way to pay.

[PayPal UK fees](https://www.paypal.com/uk/business/paypal-business-fees)

---

![square-logo](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/1usVU99QTc623Z1qK0LnerrVUCFuaCZRY9kzKFoWI_Gdr9NcpX1vWKOmILymiErxn6ndDcZZ0Or5-PjPVYj_lTK1K9NB9Q8Cck3TogeQjE13w7S0OC_soTbxUb84o9oqvCcpbffi8RgWQf3ncfxvUqtopiXbgd9lTiIMfcExXBRU8XgKgcPu-V2QhGDsZYzn?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Square**

- Straightforward setup.
- Online and in-person payment processing.
- Free basic online selling options.
- Useful inventory and sales management.

Best for: Businesses selling online and face-to-face.

[Square UK payments](https://squareup.com/gb/en/payments/online-payments)

---

![Shopify Payments w Polsce – jak działa, koszty, wdrożenie, zalety - Adtrip](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/tzlxg0Y9z5dRoMa7puRQ5gUF-G3hcQ7FEcuVco38BEG917LKXepufVl9cw-FwTKDdqoHqkcHNs202c43Bsg-KXxlvnrYPNEJMBSIYJqLREQ2DlgIvAOQgkKyUCOU_zdRd59gIwC2e-5cs0YCLvv_6mYa-9FiK4qFkvvkawoheALPlNv3AkWQkvUMElw-UVk8?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Shopify Payments**

- Integrated directly into Shopify.
- Simple payment management.
- Supports major cards and digital wallets.
- Can avoid additional Shopify third-party transaction fees.

Best for: Stores already using Shopify.

[Shopify Payments](https://www.shopify.com/uk/payments)

---

![Mollie pinautomaat kosten (2026) · gratis vergelijken](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/D57_7d7oSy02s6yl1zjAav-Yxgf4LUZZPYDHYzFt_wNqCHlBqkrhAHplhYfBTJOJy91u1bEQYVbEZXh_gEzRP8VoyGIrNDZVtuNQGJCvwJQrSLcgSZ7d7a0ve45WpqW-VHK_GV5JgM8myiK1AujLCh4qHlURg2gBe2EoWYpui5Qphgo8QfSPgrRjtevRCmLH?purpose=fullsize)

**5\. Mollie**

- Competitive European payment processing.
- Supports multiple payment methods.
- No standard monthly fee.
- Useful for businesses selling across Europe.

Best for: Small stores with European customers.

[Mollie pricing](https://www.mollie.com/pricing)

Indicative UK pricing and features checked against published 2026 comparisons. Actual fees depend on card type, location and payment method. ## My recommendation

For a typical small online store\:

- Use Stripe as your main card processor.
- Add PayPal as an alternative checkout option.
- Avoid monthly payment-processing contracts when you're just starting out.
- Compare international card fees if you intend to sell overseas.
